display.purpose: Young Serif 400 for page and section titles. Never bold or italic.

display-hero.purpose: Landing hero and section headings only.

body.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, 15 to 16px; 12px is the floor.

urdu.purpose: Noto Nastaliq Urdu applied to the whole document under dir=rtl.

shadows.name: topbar
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift under the sticky top bar.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Border, background and shadow transitions on buttons, fields and cards.

motion.name: ease-tab
motion.purpose: Top bar tab hover and active.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill action button; green fill, darker on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #236B44; color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #174B31; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,107,68,0.16); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White pill with a hairline border for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #E7EDE0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #1F2E24; font-family: var(--font-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FAFBF8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,107,68,0.16); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The one field style: 48px, 1.5px border, 12px radius, green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid #D4E0CB; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1F2E24; font-family: var(--font-primary); font-size: 15px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B776C; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #E4F1DD; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #236B44; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,107,68,0.16); }

components.name: Top Bar Tabs
components.description: Shared portal tabs; active tab gets a green wash.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: #6B776C; font-family: var(--font-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(35,107,68,0.04); color: #236B44; } .ds-tab.active { background: rgba(35,107,68,0.08); color: #236B44; border-color: rgba(35,107,68,0.12); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,107,68,0.16); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White container with hairline border and ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #E7EDE0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1F2E24; font-family: var(--font-primary); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

components.name: Pickup Summary
components.description: Compact saved-location row with icon tile and pill edit button.
components.html:
●
Pickup locationPlot 12, Sheikhupura Road
components.css: .ds-pickup { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border: 1px solid #E7EDE0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; font-family: var(--font-primary); } .ds-pickup-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px; background: #E4F1DD; color: #236B44; } .ds-pickup-text { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-pickup-text strong { font-size: 16px; color: #1F2E24; } .ds-pickup-text span { font-size: 15px; color: #6B776C; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pickup-edit { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1.5px solid #D4E0CB; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #236B44; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-pickup-edit:hover { border-color: #236B44; background: #E4F1DD; } .ds-pickup-edit:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,107,68,0.16); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: 68px round tile with a drawn crop icon and name beneath.

components.description: Inline error message under a form.

narrative.overview:
Farm2Fork is one product in two shells: the Flutter app and this web app share role colours, badge meanings and token values. The system is calm, green and legible, with pale green-tinted paper surfaces, deep green-black text, and one saturated voice, Field Green (#236B44).

Type does the personality work: Young Serif at a single weight for titles, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything operational, Noto Nastaliq Urdu for RTL. The public landing page is the editorial extension of the same world: near-white paper, near-black ink, a softer green and sand accent, with drawn icons in place of numerals.

This pass extends the incumbent green theme; it did not replace it.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green (#236B44) is the only saturated accent in the app shell; yellow and blue are semantic.
Display serif for page and section titles, hyperlegible sans for all else, Nastaliq for Urdu.
Pill buttons, large rounded cards (16px), 12px fields.
Soft ambient shadows only; borders in pale green-grey do most of the separating.
One custom icon family: round-capped 1.75px outline with an off-register tint fill.
One shared page gutter and container for every portal.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: In the app shell, green is the only brand accent. Blue and yellow carry meaning (info, pending), never decoration.

rules.name: The Defined Token Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from a named token. --border-light, --border-color and --text-main exist as aliases; do not reference a custom property that is not defined.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Young Serif is loaded at 400 only. Never bold, italicise or ask for another weight; the browser would synthesise it.

rules.name: The Legible Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set below 12px; secondary text is 13px or more; body is 15 to 16px.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a 1px or 1.5px green-grey border; shadows stay under 8% black.

rules.name: The One Icon Hand Rule
rules.body: New icons are added to art.ts in the outline-plus-tint construction. Do not mix in a second style.

dos: Do take colour, spacing and radii from the :root tokens, and extend app/globals.css before reaching for Tailwind utilities.
Do use --font-display for page and panel titles at weight 400, and --font-primary for everything else.
Do keep text at 12px minimum, secondary text at 13px or more, body at 15 to 16px.
Do use --page-gutter and --page-max for any new page-level container.
Do build new fields to the one field style: 48px, 1.5px Surface Strong border, 12px radius, 3px green focus ring.
Do draw new icons in the shared outline-plus-tint construction and pass --icon-tint for context colour.
Do provide the Urdu face and RTL behaviour for buyer, farmer and transporter text.
donts: Don't bold, italicise or substitute another weight for Young Serif.
Don't reference a custom property that is not defined in :root.
Don't add a second saturated accent to the app shell or use blue and yellow decoratively.
Don't make the landing page a generic SaaS template; keep the paper-and-ink editorial identity.
Don't invent testimonials, logos or metrics; placeholder numbers are debt, not content.
